prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Extreme wide shot. The great arc of a rainbow spans from mountain to mountain over a shining green valley, tiny figures in silhouette, in ankle-length rough undyed wool robes and head-cloths, barefoot, beneath it. Golden light. Peace. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
